name: honbako-film
description: Deterministic 45-second Honbako film, HTML canvas renderFrame(t) + RealityKit device + Playwright + ffmpeg.

scripts.render: node tools/render.mjs --format landscape && node tools/render.mjs --format portrait
scripts.storyboard: rm -rf review/storyboard && node tools/render.mjs --stills --format landscape --out review/storyboard --at 1.6,4.0,5.6,7.6,10.0,12.0,15.9,20.9,23.6,27.0,30.2,34.0,36.9,39.2,41.0,44.0 && ffmpeg -v error -y -pattern_type glob -i 'review/storyboard/landscape/t*.png' -vf scale=640:-1,tile=4x4:padding=6:color=0xF5F0E6 -frames:v 1 renders/storyboard.jpg
scripts.poster: node tools/render.mjs --stills --out review/poster --at 7.6 && cp review/poster/landscape/t07.60.png renders/poster-1920x1080.png && cp review/poster/portrait/t07.60.png renders/poster-1080x1920.png
